wiki.title: Laurel Libby
wiki.extract: Laurel Dawson Libby (née Munsell; born May 15, 1981) is an American politician, interior designer, and former nurse. A Republican, she is currently the representative for Maine House District 90, representing Minot and part of Auburn. She was elected to the Maine House in November 2020, 2022 and 2024.
